ph.ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ph.tr: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
ph.ru: There is no god but Allah, the One, He has no partner. To Him belong dominion and praise, and He has power over all things. (the hundredth time)

h: Whoever says after every prayer “Subhanallah” 33 times, “Al-hamdu lillah” 33 times, “Allahu akbar” 33 times, and for the hundredth time “La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah…”, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as many as the foam of the sea.

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
ru: There is no god but Allah, the One, He has no partner. To Him belong dominion and praise, and He has power over all things.
h: Whoever says this a hundred times in a day gets a reward like freeing ten slaves; a hundred good deeds are written for him, a hundred sins are erased, and he is protected from Shaytan until the evening.

ru: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him
h: Whoever says “Subhanallahi wa bihamdih” a hundred times in a day, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as many as the foam of the sea.

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
ru: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Great
h: Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scales and beloved to the Most Merciful: “Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, subhanallahil-'Azim”.

ru: I ask Allah for forgiveness and repent to Him
h: The Prophet ﷺ said: “By Allah, I ask Allah for forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day”. And also: “O people, repent to Allah — I repent to Him a hundred times a day”.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
tr: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad
ru: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
h: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever blesses me once, Allah blesses him ten times”.

ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
tr: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
ru: No one has strength or power except Allah
h: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Musa: “Shall I not show you one of the treasures of Paradise? It is ‘La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah’”.
